# Ande Schurr · Production Sound Mixer

> Ande Schurr is a production sound mixer and sound department head based in
> Singapore, working across Southeast Asia, Australia and New Zealand. He records
> location sound for feature films, high-end television drama and documentary.
> He received a 2026 Primetime Emmy nomination for Outstanding Sound Mixing for a
> Limited or Anthology Series or Movie for "Lord of the Flies" (BBC / Netflix),
> filmed on location in Langkawi, Malaysia.

## Facts

- Full name: Ande Schurr
- Role: Production Sound Mixer, Sound Recordist, Sound Department Head (HOD)
- Company: Schurr Productions Pte. Ltd.
- Based: Singapore
- Works across: Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Australia, New Zealand
- Nationality: New Zealand citizen, with full working rights in Australia and New Zealand
- Experience: 20 years
- Email: ande@schurrsound.com
- Phone: +65 9052 6526
- Website: https://schurrsound.com

## Awards and nominations

- 2026 Primetime Emmy nomination, Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Limited or
  Anthology Series or Movie, for "Lord of the Flies" (BBC / Netflix)

## Selected credits

- Lord of the Flies (2026, BBC / Netflix, drama series), dir. Marc Munden. Filmed in Langkawi, Malaysia
- Monkey Man (2024, Universal Pictures, feature film), dir. Dev Patel. Filmed in Indonesia and Mumbai
- Mr Midnight (2022, Netflix, TV series), dir. Tony Tilse. Filmed in Singapore and Indonesia
- Somebody Feed Phil, Singapore (2020, Netflix, documentary series)
- Vet Gone Wild (2019, Animal Planet, documentary series), filmed across Costa Rica, Namibia, Vietnam, Thailand, Australia, Fiji
- Oceans Apart: Art and the Pacific (2018, BBC, documentary series), filmed in New Zealand
- Hunt for the Wilderpeople (2016, Piki Films, feature film), dir. Taika Waititi. Filmed in New Zealand

## Services

- Production sound mixing for feature film and television drama
- Location sound recording for documentary
- Corporate and commercial location sound in Singapore and Malaysia
- Sound equipment dry hire across Southeast Asia
- PA and event audio with operator, Singapore

## Equipment

Sound Devices recorders, Wisycom wireless RF (12 channels), DPA microphones,
Sanken and Sennheiser boom microphones, timecode and comms. The full drama
package is airline-checkable and travels as luggage.
